== Biography ==
John Glasgow was baptized at Kirknewton and East Calder on 18 May 1755. His birth date is unproved; the sources support birth on or before that baptism, not an exact birthday. The imported exact date 18 May 1755 is retained here as the earlier profile claim, not as an established birth date. The transcript names father John Glasgow and mother Mary Robertson. Adult profile Glasgow-1343 remains the probable father comparison at 82%; the record-defined name alone does not uniquely establish that adult identity.
